overall_assessment: The Searchright registry publication configuration accurately adheres to upstream specifications across the official MCP Registry, Glama, and Smithery ecosystems. The root server.json conforms to the modelcontextprotocol registry schema with correct repository, packaging, transport, and runtime definitions. Glama and Smithery metadata files specify deterministic capabilities and environment bounds. The submission script (submit-registries.sh) implements strict dry-run guards preventing accidental unauthenticated network writes.

findings.description: server.json correctly targets the official MCP Registry schema format with stdio transport definition and explicit capability declarations.
findings.recommendation: Maintain alignment as the MCP registry schema draft stabilizes.

findings.description: Smithery and Glama registry documents validate repository targets, environment flags, and command dispatch without leaking sensitive parameters.
findings.recommendation: Review registry manifest tags synchronously during future version promotions.

findings.description: registry/status.json maintains an honest 'prepared_not_submitted' state across all targets with explicit gating dependencies.
findings.recommendation: Retain this status until external registry publication receipts are recorded.

calibration_notes: Registry evaluators endorse the metadata validity and dry-run guard invariants. All assertions correctly bound claims to source/fixture verification without premature publication claims.
